images.bg/city: Anime background art, high-budget anime film style, no characters, no text. A hillside harbor town at dusk: stone stairways and steep tiled roofs climbing a green hill, paper and glass lanterns strung across narrow lanes, a small lighthouse on the cape, the calm sea below, warm apricot and rose sky fading to violet, the first lanterns being lit, soft floating sparks of light. Painterly cel-shaded, crisp detail, cinematic composition with depth, 4:3.
images.bg/night: Anime background art, high-budget anime film style, no characters, no text. The same hillside harbor town at night: thousands of warm lanterns glowing along the stairways and roofs, their reflections on the dark sea, a lit lighthouse on the cape, deep blue-violet starry sky with a large soft moon, tiny glowing motes rising from the lanterns like fireflies. Peaceful and magical. Painterly cel-shaded, crisp detail, cinematic composition with depth, 4:3.
images.bg/circle: Anime background art, high-budget anime film style, no characters, no text. Dramatic sky above the hillside harbor town seen from a high stone terrace: a gigantic glowing sigil of concentric rings and lantern-flame shapes floats in the sky, beams of warm light radiating, clouds lit from below in magenta and gold, sparks of light rising from every lantern in the town toward the sigil. Epic, tense, climactic. Painterly cel-shaded, crisp detail, cinematic composition with depth, 4:3.
images.bg/barrier: Anime background art, high-budget anime film style, no characters, no text. Inside the Shadow Veil, a world swallowed by darkness: an endless twilight forest of tall black ink-wash trees and broken stone lanterns, drifting veils of smoky black cloth hanging from the sky, the ground a mirror of still dark water, a few dim lantern lights struggling in the gloom, indigo and plum palette with faint crimson glints. Eerie, quiet, dreamlike. Painterly cel-shaded, crisp detail, cinematic composition with depth, 4:3.
images.bg/clock: Anime background art, high-budget anime film style, no characters, no text. The interior of an old clock tower used as a lantern keepers' shrine: wooden beams and spiral stairs, a giant translucent clock dial seen from behind with moonlight shining through, hundreds of small hanging lanterns of violet and gold glass at different heights, slow drifting dust and light motes. Mysterious, solemn, beautiful. Painterly cel-shaded, crisp detail, cinematic composition with depth, 4:3.
images.bg/despair: Anime background art, high-budget anime film style, no characters, no text. A black storm devouring the hillside harbor town: a colossal swirling vortex of pitch-black clouds over the sea, the town's lanterns going dark one by one, rooftops and lantern strings torn into the wind, violet lightning, a towering wave, rain, a sickly crimson glow on the horizon. Despair, overwhelming scale. Painterly cel-shaded, crisp detail, cinematic composition with depth, 4:3.
images.bg/abyss: Anime background art, high-budget anime film style, no characters, no text. The deep sea far below the harbor: sunken stone ruins and a drowned lighthouse covered with glowing coral, enormous ancient whale bones arching overhead, schools of bioluminescent fish, rising bubbles, faint shafts of light from the surface far above, deep blue and aquamarine palette with pale gold glints. Melancholic and vast. Painterly cel-shaded, crisp detail, cinematic composition with depth, 4:3.
images.bg/gold: Anime background art, high-budget anime film style, no characters, no text. Radiant celebration of light: an immense golden radiance bursting from the center of the sky, god rays in all directions, thousands of glowing sky lanterns rising into a sky of gold and pink clouds, a glittering cosmos beyond, rainbow prism flares and sparkles everywhere. Euphoric, triumphant. Symmetric composition. Painterly cel-shaded, crisp detail, cinematic composition with depth, 4:3.
images.bg/rush: Anime background art, high-budget anime film style, no characters, no text. High-speed flight through a tunnel of light: countless glowing lanterns and streaks of pink, violet, gold and cyan light rushing toward a bright vanishing point at the center, spiral ribbons of light and sparks, motion lines. Exhilarating, fast, energetic, vivid. Painterly cel-shaded, crisp detail, cinematic composition with depth, 4:3.
